## 

In this document, I'm going to analyse the tumor progression of the *In vivo* 1 of my master's dissertation.

## Let's plot the data

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| dev: png
getwd()

library(tidyverse)
library(magick)
library(ggsci)

tumorData <- read.csv("TumorGrowth1.csv")

tumorPlot <- ggplot(
  tumorData,
  aes(day, volume, color = group)
) + geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = volume-std,
      ymax = volume+std
    ),
    width = 0.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Tumor Progression In Vivo 1",
    y = "Volume(mm³)",
    x = "days after graft"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    )
  )

tumorPlot
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "TumorPlot_invivo1.pdf",
  plot = tumorPlot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)
```
